evidence_quote: proposing a fast forest quantile regression algorithm to predict the energy demand response
The parameters selected are production, energy consumption and functioning hours.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study represents a new hardware, software, and data processing infrastructure for open-pit mines

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: FFQR models energy consumption vs production+functioning hours (EnB-type model embedded in a monitoring/software design); paper never uses EnPI/EnB/baseline terms. Application is an open-pit mine (mining/extractive) with continuous conveyor-based material handling: A9=continuous process chosen as the only definitionally-admissible enum bucket, but mining is unlisted in the closed 3B list, so level_3b=false and flagged for human decision.

multi_site.evidence_quote: tested on the experimental open-pit mine of Benguerir

country_region.evidence_quote: the experimental open-pit mine of Benguerir

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: bucket wheel reclaimers, stackers, draglines, jaw crushers, conveyors, screening and loading stations

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: the fast forest quantile regression can estimate the predictor variable effect based on the mean and conditional quantile
